## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, the changed result and the bounded scope. Link the
relevant issue or acceptance record when available.

## Validation

Record commands and observed results. Include seed/worker count for randomized
runs and any blocked check. Record measured collection and retain existing
CI/coverage/tool requirements.

## Applicable evidence and operator notes

For UI changes, attach the evidence required by the acceptance record. Use a
DOM alternative only where that record explicitly accepts it.
For changed procedures, record a disposable rehearsal. Explain schema/role,
source-interpretation, upgrade/recovery or deployment effects when applicable;
otherwise this section can be removed.

Keep credentials, private endpoints, real source records and personal data out
of the diff and evidence. Report possible vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md.
Update the affected contract and instructions, and retain required third-party
notices for introduced material.
